scope: Every CONTENT_CHECKS_PASS record of CLAUDE-RELEASE-MASTER.md whose Danish edition is already live (27 books).
reconciliation: Each candidate was hash-compared with main (Danish body, paired English, both guides), then classified paragraph by paragraph against main's copy of the modern-da-quality package (books/wip/modern-da-quality-20261102, the source of #818) and its INTEGRATION-2026-11-13.json. The recovered-branch Danish bodies equal that package exactly; every remaining Danish difference is one of #818's 45 integration adjustments, which main keeps. Their English differences are the package's modern-en repairs, which #818 did not publish ("they need their own English release"); the English base each review started from equals main's live English, so they apply cleanly. Confessions and Middlemarch: the source snapshots in their folders equal main byte for byte (Confessions) or are main at a1ee0ffd with no later change (Middlemarch), so the recovered revisions replace nothing newer.
releasedAtNote: Edition releasedAt re-pinned at merge to 2026-11-19T03:35:00Z, just after the expected go-live. Re-pin it if the merge lands later; it must not be earlier than the deploy.
